resources.string: Allows to intercept app notifications to display on the watch
This permission, while dangerous, is necessary for the Indicator feature. The background service intercepts all notifications, then convert them to indicators to display on the watch.
Must be set to allow uninterrupted service
A background service needs to be running at all time. Please also consider marking it as \"not optimized for battery\".
Must be set to allow uninterrupted service
Read the telephony service state: cell coverage, 4G/5G
Needed to check Bluetooth adapter state
Also needed for continuous monitoring of Bluetooth and WiFi
Basic access to location information, needed to further access WiFi and Bluetooth states
Needed to retrieve Bluetooth device\'s battery level
In order for the background service not to be killed, a permanent (silent) notification must be registered.
This is needed to access the telephony service state, and receive real-time information when the coverage changes.
This allows the app to be notified when a Bluetooth device is connected or disconnected.
The app doesn\'t actually connect to Bluetooth devices.
This is needed to query WiFi state as well as the connected SSID, and be notified when something changes.
The background service must receive notice of any changes in WiFi connection, that use case is covered by this permission.
Without this permission, the app can\'t retrieve and display an application\'s icon when looking for an app to set an Indicator.
